messages:
mike: heads-up — i'm about to land a terraform change to the autoscaler module. changes:
- bump cluster-autoscaler min_nodes 3 -> 4
- add provisioner annotations for Karpenter backoff/consolidation
- switch HPA target CPU -> targetUtilization 60
- add a VPA for batch-worker to help with memory spikes
- move metrics secret reference from k8s secret 'metrics-token' to AWS SecretsManager via IRSA
Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1421
Need quick :eyes: for compat & any gotchas before I merge.

anya: quick Q — what's the expected pod density with CA min=4? worried about bin-packing on gp4dn nodes.

sanjay: VPA looks okay generally but we should avoid enabling auto-update for stateful sets. can you paste the vpa yaml?

mike: vpa snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: batch-worker
spec:
  targetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: batch-worker
  updatePolicy:
    updateMode: Auto
  resourcePolicy:
    containerPolicies:
      - containerName: '*'
        minAllowed:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 128Mi
```

lisa: LGTM on VPA shape, but if HPA will scale on CPU and VPA is `Auto` we might get resource fights. suggest VPA control only memory (controlledResources: ["memory"]) and leave CPU to HPA.

pradeep: for the secrets move — do we have the IAM role and IRSA mapping for the karpenter node profile to read the secret? if new provisioner creates nodes, they need permission. also update the prometheus service account annotation.

mike: the PR includes the IAM role binding and an aws_iam_policy_attachment. snippet in terraform:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "sm_read" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.karpenter_nodes.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.secretsmanager_read.arn
}
module "secrets" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//secrets?ref=v1.3"
  store  = "aws_sm"
}
```

devops-bot: preview env created: preview-autoscale-1421.redwood.internal — helm deployed, smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

anya: couple of process nitpicks — add a changelog entry, link the infra ticket, and canary in staging for 2 hours before prod. i'll +1 after canary.

sanjay: also double-check provisioner consolidation settings — we saw pod churn in last incident when consolidation kicked in aggressively. maybe disable consolidation for a few hours post-deploy or set `consolidation: { enabled: false }`.

mike: noted. i'll set provisioner: `consolidation: disabled` and `ttlSecondsUntilExpired: 300` to avoid immediate consolidation. will run canary in staging and ping back. pinging @lisa for final review.

lisa: on it, reviewing now — should have comments in ~15m :eyes:

mike: thanks all. merging after staging canary + lisa +1 and pradeep confirms IRSA role exists.
